searchText: Hi, just for educational purpose: I am just wondering the original PoW Ethereum, does valid transactions from ommer blocks are also included, or are we just using its hashes? you can get rewarded for including valid ommer headers, but the bodies are not executed in any fashion if you came across ommers and they had transactions new to you and not yet included on chain they could go into future blocks
